title: Crash when switching workspaces
body:
_The STRs are quite long for now; I will trim a few things once I'm done refining_

1. New project (Ctrl+N) **A**
2. New 48 kHz track 
3. Generate 3 noise clips on the track, copy them
4. New project (Ctrl+N) **B**
5. Generate a chirp
6. Paste (Ctrl+V) alongside the chirp
7. Play, stop
8. Close the source project **A**
9. Switch workspace by selecting a different one in the dropdown in the top right
10. Observe: it crashes Audacity.

Logs:
